declarations.description:
`citation-element`
An element dedicated to presenting and managing a correct citation on the web
both visually as well as semantically with simple inputs.
declarations.name: CitationElement

members.name: _fillTemplate
members.description:
splits a translated sentence on {placeholders} and swaps in the
matching values (strings or templates) so links stay inside one string

members.name: tag
members.description: convention

members.name: _generateLicenseLink
members.description: Generate a license link whenever we have a source

members.name: _generateAboutLink
members.description: Generate an about link whenever we have a related resource and license link

members.name: _scopeChanged
members.description: Notice scope change.

members.name: haxProperties
members.description: Attached to the DOM, now fire.

members.name: _licenseDisplayName
members.description: translated license name for display; custom licenseName values pass through

members.name: _licenseUpdated
members.description: License was updated, time to update license name and link.

members.name: t
members.default: { ...this.t, citationWithLicense: "{title} by {creator}, licensed under {license}. Accessed {date}.", citationWithoutLicense: "{title} by {creator}. Accessed {date}.", licenseGraphic: "{license} graphic", licenseBy: "Attribution", licenseBySa: "Attribution Share a like", licenseByNd: "Attribution No derivatives", licenseByNc: "Attribution non-commercial", licenseByNcSa: "Attribution non-commercial share a like", licenseByNcNd: "Attribution Non-commercial No derivatives", }

members.name: scope
members.description: License scope

members.name: source
members.description: Original Source of the work in question

members.name: typeof
members.description:
OER Schema class for the cited work (default oer:ReferencedMaterial).
Authors can override via the HAX editor to use a more specific OER class.

members.name: title
members.description: Title of the work.

members.name: displayMethod
members.description:
How to present the citation on the interface.
Can be popup, footnote, or default behavior which is visible

members.name: creator
members.description: Person or group that owns / created the work.

members.name: date
members.description: Date the work was accessed.

members.name: licenseName
members.description: License name, calculated or supplied by the end user if we don't have them.

members.name: licenseLink
members.description: License link for more details

members.name: licenseImage
members.description: License image URL, calculated when a known license is applied.

members.name: license
members.description: License short hand. Options cc0,

members.name: relatedResource
members.description:
Related resource id used to bind the citation to a sibling or parent.
Calculated by `_scopeChanged`; declared here so reactive updates and
`updated()` react to it via Lit.
